name: 'Dan Cooper', the unidentified hijacker (1971)
depiction: Illustrated representation, not a likeness: the man has never been identified. Only the widely published generic description is used (dark business suit, white shirt, black tie, dark sunglasses, short dark hair). The face is generic and is never based on any suspect, sketch or photograph.
rules: Never glamorised and never given a suspect's features. Always in dark sunglasses. No weapon or bomb contents are shown. Every shot he appears in is tagged ILLUSTRATION · NOT A LIKENESS.
